List-I
List-II
Meanings

(B) Tracing descent from father to son
(II) Polygyny
(C) The practice of a man having several wives
(III) Patriliny
(D) The gift of a daughter in marriage
(IV) Kanyadana
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:

Detailed Solution:
Sanskrit texts use the term 'kula' to designate families and 'jati' for larger networks of kinfolk (A-(I)). Patriliny means tracing descent from father to son, grandson and so on (B-(III)). Polygyny is the marital practice of a man having multiple wives simultaneously (C-(II)). Kanyadana is the religious duty of the father to gift a daughter in marriage (D-(IV)). Match: (A)-(I), (B)-(III), (C)-(II), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
